overloads.semanticRole: The Get print marker command enables you to get the current position of a marker during printing.

constraints: markNum must be one of the 'Form Area' theme constants (e.g. Form header, Form detail, Form footer, Form break0..Form break9, etc.); the returned position is in pixels (1 pixel = 1/72 inch).
Only meaningful when called during the On Header form event (in the context of PRINT SELECTION / PRINT RECORD) or the On Printing Detail form event (in the context of Print form).
